zh-CN.title: 五夜星旋奖励改为手动领取
items: 完成连续五晚观测后，典藏星夜回旋背景会在活动页等待你亲自领取
历史回溯只补充观测进度，不再自动将奖励加入收藏

en.title: Five Nights rewards are now claimed manually
items: After completing five consecutive nights, claim the Collector Starry Rotation background from the event page
History backfill now restores observation progress without automatically adding the reward
